traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Specific to recipient/contact entry in money transfer flows (Send Money, Pay Bills). Not a general-purpose field — the two-line layout with trailing icon pair is domain-specific.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Carries its own border, fill, label, and text styles per state. All 4 interaction states defined. 56px height, 6px corner radius. Disabled state has distinct background.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: isFilled now uses true/false (C2 fixed). Value layer renamed to #value (C1 fixed) — now consistent with sibling fields.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Trailing icons are icon-placeholder RECTANGLEs (C6) — not swappable icon instances. Cannot compose different icon actions (phonebook, scan QR) without editing the component.

behavior.notes: Gray #D7E0EF border, white bg. Label + placeholder/value visible.
#EEF2F9 bg, border hidden. Muted label and text.

resolved.body: isFilled property renamed from Yes/No to true/false — now maps directly to Swift Bool / Kotlin Boolean C2 Fixed
Text layer renamed from #text-placeholder to #value — now consistent with sibling fields (Input Field, Labeled Field) C1 Fixed
Both trailing icons use shared Placeholder component instances — swappable by design. Internal RECTANGLE is the default visual, replaced by designers when consuming the component C6 Closed

recommendations.headline: Replace icon placeholders with swappable icon instances.
recommendations.body: The two icon-placeholder RECTANGLEs block instance-swap — phonebook, scan-QR, and other trailing actions can't be dropped in without detaching the master.

recommendations.headline: Document the 56px height rationale.
recommendations.body: Recipient Field is taller than the standard 46px form fields because of the two-line label + value layout. Call this out in the DS guidelines so it's not mistaken for a design error.

recommendations.headline: Add an errorMessage slot below the field.
recommendations.body: Inline validation text keeps the field self-contained and matches the pattern proposed for the other form fields.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Recipient Field for contact/number entry in money transfer flows (Send Money, Pay Bills, Buy Load). The two-line layout with trailing icons is purpose-built for this context.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Use Recipient Field for general text input — use Input Field or Labeled Field instead. The 56px height and icon slots add unnecessary weight for simple text entry.

usageGuidelines.doText: Provide meaningful trailing icons (e.g. contacts picker, QR scanner) that match the field's purpose. Both slots should have distinct actions.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Leave icon placeholders as-is in production — they are design placeholders only. Always replace with real icon instances before handoff.

scorecard.notes: Layer renamed to #value, now consistent with sibling fields.
Colors appear correct but token binding not verified. Icon placeholders use hardcoded #C2C6CF.
Maps to custom EBRecipientField (SwiftUI + Compose). Two-line layout with trailing icon slots.
All 4 states defined: Default, Active, Error, Disabled.
Both trailing icons are icon-placeholder RECTANGLEs — not swappable icon instances.

rows.body: #text-placeholder renamed to #value — Value text layer renamed from #text-placeholder to #value. Now consistent with sibling fields (Input Field, Labeled Field) for direct native property mapping. C1 Fixed
isFilled renamed to true/false — Figma property isFilled updated from Yes/No to true/false. Now maps directly to Swift Bool and Kotlin Boolean for Code Connect. C2 Fixed

Component assessed — 8 variants documented across State (Default/Active/Error/Disabled) × isFilled (true/false). GCash-specific two-line recipient field with trailing action icons. 56px height (vs 46px standard). Documented
Boolean property uses Yes/No — isFilled=Yes/No instead of true/false. Incompatible with Swift Bool and Kotlin Boolean for Code Connect mapping. Fixed in 1.1.0
Layer naming inconsistency — Value text layer is #text-placeholder instead of #value used by other Form Elements. Fixed in 1.2.0
Non-swappable icon placeholders — Both trailing icons are icon-placeholder RECTANGLEs, not component instances. Open
Code Connect mappings — No CLI mappings registered yet. Blocked by C1 and C6 issues. Open
